prompt:

Do NOT add any staircases, steps, balconies, galleries, railings, mezzanines, or upper floors ANYWHERE — this is a strictly SINGLE-STOREY room and every empty corner stays an empty corner (measured defect: invented staircases on 3/3 prior rooms). Preserve the EXACT COUNT and PLACEMENT of every architectural feature from the input image: the same number of pillars/columns on the same floor positions, and the same number of wall openings/doorways/arches in the same walls. Do NOT add pillars, columns, doorways, arches, gates, portcullises, niches or alcoves that are not present in the input image; walls that are solid in the input stay unbroken solid.
